style: Realistic high-end commercial photography for a premium Indian business-registration and compliance firm. Natural warm daylight, realistic Indian professionals and modern Indian offices, calm forest-green, sage and warm cream colour accents, clean editorial composition with negative space, shallow depth of field, authentic and candid. No text, no watermarks, no logos, no signage, no readable documents.
